description: Testing suite for the Everything Ecosystem agent environment. Validates that the orchestrator routes correctly, system skills operate on the right files, handoff triggers fire, and end-to-end workflows complete with proper provenance.

evals.prompt: I have a bunch of ideas about a new recipe app I've been thinking about. I just want to get them out of my head.
evals.expected_output: Orchestrator detects capture session intent. Routes to idea dump system. Ideas are captured with sequential numbering, idea statuses, and provenance metadata. No push toward classification or routing. Routing mode defaults to batch.

assertions.name: session-type-detected
assertions.check: Orchestrator identifies this as a capture session

assertions.name: idea-dump-invoked
assertions.check: Idea dump system skill is read and followed

assertions.name: ideas-numbered
assertions.check: Each idea gets a sequential number

assertions.name: statuses-assigned
assertions.check: Each idea gets an idea status

assertions.name: provenance-recorded
assertions.check: Session date and number recorded as provenance

assertions.name: no-premature-routing
assertions.check: Ideas are not routed during capture; routing is batch

assertions.name: no-classification-push
assertions.check: Framework does not push toward entity classification

evals.prompt: I have a project called BrightPath — it's a mentoring platform that connects experienced professionals with early-career developers. It has a landing page, a matching algorithm, and a Stripe integration. I want to figure out what it is and where it fits.
evals.expected_output: Orchestrator detects focused session on entity classification. Routes to entity profiling system (discovery mode). A complete entity profile is produced with all 10 sections populated or given field statuses. Documentation audit identifies gaps. Classification is proposed with reasoning, then confirmed with user.

assertions.name: discovery-mode-invoked
assertions.check: Entity profiling system is read; discovery mode process followed

assertions.name: all-sections-present
assertions.check: Entity profile contains all 10 sections

assertions.name: no-blanks
assertions.check: Every field has a value or a field status

assertions.name: classification-proposed
assertions.check: Classification is proposed with reasoning before confirmation

assertions.name: pillars-assessed
assertions.check: Product, brand, and business pillars each have lifecycle stage

assertions.name: doc-audit-included
assertions.check: Documentation audit section identifies existing vs missing docs

assertions.name: changelog-entry
assertions.check: Changelog records profile creation date and trigger

evals.prompt: Look at the active ideas in the idea dump. Items 147 through 154 are ready to be formalized into a specification document. Graduate them.
evals.expected_output: Orchestrator routes to idea dump system to identify the ideas, then to design/spec system to produce the spec document. Ideas are marked as implemented in the dump with provenance trails. Entity profile documentation audit is updated. Entity profile is the last file touched.

assertions.name: ideas-identified
assertions.check: Correct ideas (147-154) are read from the dump

assertions.name: spec-created
assertions.check: A specification document is created with the graduated ideas

assertions.name: spec-implementation-ready
assertions.check: Spec is structured for handoff to implementation agents

assertions.name: provenance-recorded
assertions.check: Each idea gets provenance trail showing graduation to spec

assertions.name: ideas-cleared
assertions.check: Ideas marked as implemented, not left active

assertions.name: audit-updated
assertions.check: Entity profile documentation audit reflects new spec document

assertions.name: entity-profile-last
assertions.check: Entity profile is the last file modified in the workflow

evals.prompt: How is my ecosystem looking? What should I focus on this week?
evals.expected_output: Orchestrator routes to diagnostic system. Diagnostic reads all idea dumps, entity profiles, and session log. Surfaces implementation lag, inactivity signals, and clustering if present. Produces strategic recommendations linked to specific session types.

assertions.name: diagnostic-invoked
assertions.check: Diagnostic system skill is read and followed

assertions.name: dumps-analyzed
assertions.check: All active idea dumps are read and analyzed

assertions.name: entity-profiles-checked
assertions.check: Entity profiles are read for lifecycle status

assertions.name: lag-detected-if-present
assertions.check: Implementation lag is identified if ideas are aging

assertions.name: recommendations-actionable
assertions.check: Recommendations suggest specific session types or actions

assertions.name: skeptical-not-praising
assertions.check: Diagnostic is tuned toward finding problems, not confirming health

assertions.name: no-structural-changes
assertions.check: Diagnostic does not create files or modify structure

evals.prompt: I've been dumping ideas all session. Show me what's queued for routing and let me decide where things go.
evals.expected_output: Orchestrator routes to routing system. Routing system reads the idea dump and entity hierarchy. Presents a visible queue of ideas with suggested targets. For each idea, proposes a destination dump. Waits for user confirmation before executing routes. Provenance chains recorded for each movement.

assertions.name: routing-invoked
assertions.check: Routing system skill is read and followed

assertions.name: queue-visible
assertions.check: Queued ideas are presented with suggested targets

assertions.name: targets-justified
assertions.check: Each suggested target is based on entity hierarchy

assertions.name: user-confirms-before-move
assertions.check: No ideas are moved without user confirmation

assertions.name: provenance-on-move
assertions.check: Each routed idea gets provenance chain entries in both dumps

assertions.name: metadata-updated
assertions.check: Dump metadata updated in both source and target dumps

assertions.name: dump-to-dump-only
assertions.check: Ideas route to other dumps, never directly to implementation

evals.prompt: Hey, I'm back. What were we working on?
evals.expected_output: Orchestrator detects return session. Routes to session management for 'Previously on...' recap. Session management reads the most recent session log entry and delivers the recap in the fun show-name format. Transitions to session calibration after recap.

assertions.name: return-detected
assertions.check: Orchestrator identifies this as a return session

assertions.name: session-log-read
assertions.check: Most recent session log entry is read

assertions.name: recap-delivered
assertions.check: Recap is delivered in 'Previously on...' format

assertions.name: show-name-used
assertions.check: A fun show name is used for the recap framing

assertions.name: transition-to-calibration
assertions.check: After recap, orchestrator asks what to work on today

evals.prompt: I'd like to create my person profile. I'm the owner, CEO of the reference project. I'm a developer and systems thinker. I have several projects: Another project (open source, passion), another project (commercial, building), and a news app concept (early exploration).
evals.expected_output: Orchestrator routes to person profile system. Person profile created with all schema sections. Capacities listed with development levels. Projects listed with commitment type, emotional investment, time horizon, and intended outcome. Context section captures any offhand remarks.

assertions.name: person-profile-invoked
assertions.check: Person profile system skill is read and followed

assertions.name: all-sections-present
assertions.check: Profile contains all schema sections (Identity through Context)

assertions.name: capacities-listed
assertions.check: Developer and systems thinker captured as capacities

assertions.name: projects-with-metadata
assertions.check: Each project has commitment, investment, horizon, outcome

assertions.name: ceo-position-noted
assertions.check: CEO position is distinguished from person capacities

assertions.name: changelog-entry
assertions.check: Changelog records profile creation

evals.prompt: Let me start by dumping some ideas about a new feature for another project... [ideas]... actually, let me look at the entity profile for another project and update the product pillar... and while we're at it, what does my idea dump backlog look like?
evals.expected_output: Orchestrator detects multi-modal session. Transitions between systems: idea dump (capture) → entity profiling (review/update) → diagnostic (backlog check). Each transition is tracked. At session end, session log captures sub-session transitions.

assertions.name: multi-modal-detected
assertions.check: Orchestrator recognizes multi-modal session

assertions.name: transitions-tracked
assertions.check: Each system transition is noted by the orchestrator

assertions.name: idea-capture-correct
assertions.check: Ideas captured properly during capture phase

assertions.name: entity-profile-updated
assertions.check: Entity profile updated during review phase

assertions.name: diagnostic-runs
assertions.check: Diagnostic provides backlog analysis when requested

assertions.name: session-log-captures-transitions
assertions.check: Session log entry notes the sub-session type shifts

assertions.name: audit-trigger-fires
assertions.check: Entity profile audit updated after any document changes
